reasoning.intent_reason: '经常' is a habitual-intervention marker similar to '每天'; user asks the effect of sustained staying-up-late, not the abstract causal pathway
reasoning.confounder_note: Staying up late is a self-selected behavior (§3 unit 1: observed confounder). A latent driver — work/study stress or workload — makes a person both more likely to stay up late (deadlines, overwork) AND directly impairs cognition (chronic stress harms memory/attention independent of sleep). So staying_up_late→cognitive_decline is confounded by work_stress even though sleep deprivation has a real direct mechanism. Emit the direct edge AND the confounder (C→X, C→Y, all llm_proposal); identification routes through backdoor adjustment over work_stress and the kernel flags its missing data — not a bare P(cognitive_decline | staying_up_late).
reasoning.framing_left_blank: The user gave no time scale ('occasionally' vs 'every night for a year'?), no definition of 'cognitive decline' (working memory? reaction time? self-report?), and no measurement method. The framing fields stay unset so A0/F1 flags them.
